pages.text: $(l)Performance matters.$() Pipes are a common source of lag.$(li)$(l)Thermal itemducts and conduit bundles hurt TPS.$() Ducts are fine for 1-to-1 links but bad for networks. Make them opaque.$(li)EnderIO conduits all tick, so use them in moderation.
$(li)$(l)XNet$() is the best for complex setups. Later, AE2 is best of all.

$(l)Cheapest early pipes:$() Thermal Dynamics. Add a servo to extract and enable it in the servo's redstone control. The lowest-tier fluid ducts $(l)break with hot fluids$(). Switch to EnderIO once it's affordable.$(br2)$(l)Actually Additions lasers:$() green = items, red = energy, blue = fluid.

Item lasers join every connected inventory into one network that you access through an Item Interface. Fluid lasers are very fast. Lasers can occasionally disconnect for good, and they're a lag source, so use the invisibility upgrade.

$(li)$(l)Energy:$() XNet, Draconic wireless crystals, Flux Networks (long distance), EnderIO in moderation, or cryo fluxducts.$(li)Tesslocators only reach 1 block. They're fine for item hand-offs but pointless for energy.
$(li)An RFTools Builder with a $(l)Pump card$() collects fluid source blocks from the world.
